purpose: Canonical domain vocabulary for pre-midi and pre-programmed. These names must govern UI, source identifiers, serialized schemas, and runtime APIs.

entities.name: Asset
entities.definition: Externally stored audio file, referenced by a relative path; binary bytes never reside inside .premidi.

entities.name: Recording
entities.definition: Captured audio source, usually a vocal take or user sound; its data is referenced as an Asset.

entities.name: Sound
entities.definition: Playable synth or sampled voice with its own sound controls.

entities.name: Rack
entities.definition: Instrument layout holding independently triggered Sounds.

entities.name: Instrument
entities.definition: Musical lane containing a pitched Sound or Rack, reusable Chunks, and Chunk placements.

entities.name: Chunk
entities.definition: Reusable one-measure note or hit pattern within one Instrument.

entities.name: Beat
entities.definition: Standalone 1–16-bar arrangement containing Instruments, Chunks, and their musical placements. May exist without a Song.

entities.name: Song
entities.definition: Extended arrangement of independently editable Beats and timeline-positioned Recordings.

entities.name: Track
entities.definition: Horizontal Song lane containing Clips of one media type. Vocal Tracks visually precede every Beat Track.

entities.name: Clip
entities.definition: Positioned, adjustable Song occurrence of a Beat or Recording; never the underlying editable Beat/Recording itself.

timing.beat: Beat is a document entity; musical beat is a time unit and must be explicit in identifiers such as beatsPerBar or beatPosition.
timing.chunk: A Chunk is within an Instrument; a Clip is placed on a Song Track.
timing.track: An Instrument lane inside a Beat is not a Song Track.

historical.composition: Deprecated name for the Beat document. Do not introduce new uses.
historical.score: Deprecated variable name for a Beat document. Existing identifiers must be migrated deliberately.
historical.songStep: Legacy Beat-timeline step; use beatStep for Beat-local timing.
historical.versioning: Existing .premidi v5/v6/v7 inputs must remain readable through migrations; never silently reinterpret old serialized fields.

invariants: Beat editing remains independent and primary.
Song references Beats by identity; Clips never flatten Beat audio.
Song layout always renders Vocal Tracks above Beat Tracks, with selected Beat editor beneath.
A single native definition is consumable by pre-programmed.
The browser host must not determine the core format.
